result_text: Both repository-name tooltips in the landscape report now escape the name, so quotes and HTML in a repository name stay inside the tooltip text. The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`: - **Language blocks** (`addLangInfo(NumericMetric)`, ~line 1198): the repository name is passed through `StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml4` before the `(N LOC)` suffix is appended. - **Size distribution table** (`addZooSection`, ~line 1455): the same escaping is applied to the repository name before the LOC value is appended. - Added the `org.apache.commons.text.StringEscapeUtils` import. `commons-text` is already a dependency of the reports module and is used the same way in `ScopesRenderer` and `DuplicationReportUtils`. Newlines, counts, order and layout are unchanged, since only the name text is escaped. `acme "shop"` now renders in the tooltip as `acme "shop" (5,000 LOC)` (or `acme "shop" 5000` in the size table). `mvn -o -pl reports compile` succeeds. The reports module has no tests covering the landscape generator, so I did not run a test and did not render a report to check the tooltip in a browser. Nothing is committed.
